summary: The quietest week on this account since onboarding — 6 messages, and Callie's entire participation was a single 90-minute burst on Aug 17 in which she delivered everything asked of her and then went silent for four days. She uploaded 48 videos ('Have uploaded 48 vids to the drive 🤍') and paid the Aug 1-14 invoice two days after receiving it ('Sent:)'), the fastest and first frictionless payment cycle of the relationship. What came back was 'Thank you love!' and 'yayyy perfect babes tyyy 🫶🏼' — two emoji acknowledgements and nothing else. No confirmation the money landed, no answer to the duplicate-payment question she asked on Aug 8 (now 13 days unanswered), no plan for the 48 videos, no reel-inspo drop from Mica for the first week since Jul 10, and a third consecutive week of total silence from Derrek and Vivek on the phone-farm / IG posting rollout promised on Aug 1. There is also a live payment risk: Stephski's Aug 15 invoice said 'Please note an update to the account number', but back on Jul 13 she had told Callie 'we can just repeat to the same account for this next period of invoicing' — and nobody has verified which account Callie's Aug 17 wire actually went to. She has stopped asking for things. That is the signal this week, not the low message count.
